content: Has there been any work in integrating webkit with the infoview? I and @Kiran are thinking about writing such a plugin on top of nael-mode

Mainly for exploration and self-education I coded this https://gitlab.com/castedo/sideinfoview which might be useful to look at/copy for what you thinking. I have been looking into embedding infoview in any web browser window with any editor with LSP support, that is LSP-editor running on local personal computer and infoview inside a website showing proof state of the local Lean file on your local file system. I plan to post more about it this week.

@Leni Aniva I have this infoview integration that talks to Emacs via jsonrpc over websocket:

https://github.com/lua-vr/lean-ts-mode/blob/main/lean-ts-infoview.el

It's not very polished (as isn't the rest of the repo), but it's what I'm using.
It uses eglot, so it shouldn't be hard to port it for nael.
Thanks @Lua Viana Reis for sharing that code. It was nice to see your code along with other example to help me code https://gitlab.com/castedo/pleansidekick

A hosted version of that repo is at https://p.lean.castedo.com/ but it's just a react app that can run locally or other domain. Not sure if that code might useful to you @Leni Aniva I'm not an Emacs user so i'm not totally sure what webkit integration with Emacs looks like.
